init.default_locale: Default language for business documentation (description, intent, outcome)
init.next_step_web: In the browser: `doklo serve --open` — start with the onboarding wizard
init.next_step_cli: In the terminal: `doklo generate` — scan + generate Doks in one go, then `doklo show`
init.handoff_choose: How would you like to continue?
init.handoff_browser: Open Doklo web in your browser (Recommended)
init.handoff_opening: Opening {url} in your browser. Press Ctrl+C to stop web.
init.handoff_recovery: Your initialized workspace is preserved at {path}. Retry with `doklo serve --open`.
init.handoff_port_fallback: Port {preferred} is in use — using {port} instead.
init.model_hint: Auto-detected from your environment — pick any provider
init.auth_intro: Authenticate {provider} so Doklo can make API calls
init.auth_skip: Skipping auth — set {env} to authenticate later
init.model_registry_unavailable: Could not reach the model registry, so the model step was skipped. Your workspace is ready — run `doklo model` to choose a model and `doklo auth` to sign in when you are back online.
init.scan_failed: Scan skipped (couldn't parse the project yet) — run `doklo scan` later
runtime.unsupported_framework.detected: Detected framework: {name}. Doklo 0.1.0 analyzes Next.js (App Router) projects only. NestJS and Express adapters, and an AI-draft analysis mode for other frameworks, are next on the roadmap. Updates and early access: https://doklo.io/contact
runtime.unsupported_framework.unknown: Could not detect a supported framework in package.json. Doklo 0.1.0 analyzes Next.js (App Router) projects only. NestJS and Express adapters, and an AI-draft analysis mode for other frameworks, are next on the roadmap. Updates and early access: https://doklo.io/contact
scan.next_step: Next: `doklo generate` to create Doks (LLM), or `doklo serve --open` for the browser
generate.gate_cancelled: Cancelled — caches are kept. Re-run `doklo generate` to resume.
generate.gate_none: Nothing to generate — no Doks in the plan.
generate.gate_opt_studio: Adjust the plan in web (opens browser)
generate.gate_studio_return: web closed. Re-run `doklo generate` to build the edited plan.
sync.all_fresh: All {count} Dok(s) are fresh — nothing to sync.
sync.stale_rest: {count} more drifted Dok(s) at standard or lower priority
sync.unknown_note: {count} Dok(s) have no logic hash (predates drift tracking) — regenerate to start tracking.
sync.skipped_human: skipped {dokId} — edited by a human (use --force to overwrite)
sync.not_in_plan: cannot regenerate {dokId} — not in the current consolidated plan (cache changed?)
sync.plan_outdated: {dokId} changed after the last consolidate — plan may be outdated (run `doklo scan && doklo consolidate` first)
auth.pick_method: How do you want to sign in to OpenAI?
auth.browser_fallback: If the browser does not open, visit: {url}
auth.browser_waiting: Waiting for login in your browser… Terminal is still running · Ctrl+C to cancel
model.pick: Pick a model for the {role} task
model.pick_provider: Pick a provider for the {role} task
model.weak_warning: {model} has not been validated for this generation workload — inspect draft quality
model.rec_opus48: ★ benchmark pick — zero-hallucination tier for trust-critical docs
model.rec_sol: ★ benchmark pick — opus-tier quality, free on ChatGPT subscription
model.rec_luna: ★ benchmark pick — budget tier that stays accurate (API key)
model.warn_measured: {model} measured poorly on real projects (high schema-failure and hallucination rate on 300+ file apps) — consider claude-sonnet-5 or gpt-5.6-luna
mcp.no_workspace: No workspace.json found — run `doklo init` first. The server is up but tools will error until a workspace exists.
generate.batch_capped: Token limit: {kept}/{total} Doks will run; {deferred} deferred. Check remaining workspace tokens; adjust DOKLO_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RUN / DOKLO_MAX_TOKENS_TOTAL as needed before continuing.
generate.token_estimate_note: Generation only, initial attempts: prompt bytes / 4 and a rough 1,500 output tokens per Dok. Output allowance: {max} tokens, not a prediction. Cache savings and reasoning/output size are uncertain; retries cost extra.
generate.plan_details_hint: Use --plan-details for all Dok IDs, or review the plan in the web app.
generate.usage_summary: This run, including failed responses: {attempted} calls · {measured} measured · {missing} unmeasured. Measured tokens: input {input} (cache read {read}, cache creation {write} included) / output {output}.
generate.usage_comparison: Estimate for the same attempted calls: input {input} / output {output}. Actual minus estimate: input {inputDelta} / output {outputDelta} tokens.
generate.usage_incomplete: Usage is incomplete; measured totals are partial and cannot be compared with the full estimate. Unmeasured calls are not zero-token calls.
generate.deferred_end: Some Doks were deferred. Check remaining tokens and limits before running generate again; existing Doks are skipped without --force.
recording.choose: Which branch contains the product version to document?
recording.invalid: Local branch "{branch}" does not exist or is invalid. Fetch/create it first; Doklo never fetches or switches branches automatically.
recording.mismatch: Product records use "{branch}". Run this command in a clean checkout of that branch. Your current checkout was not changed.
recording.dirty: The "{branch}" checkout has source changes. Commit or move those changes before recording the product version.
recording.moved: The recording source changed during this command. Retry on a stable checkout.
recording.cache: Cached input {file} has no matching recording source. Run {command} on the configured branch first.
recording.unset: No recording branch configured; current-folder behavior is active.
agent.description: Connect Doklo skills to a coding agent
agent.preview: Show the change without writing files
agent.discovery_note: Restart or refresh the client to discover the project skill. Automatic selection depends on the client. Explicit invocation: $doklo (Codex), /doklo (Claude Code).
agent.conflict: Preserved existing or modified skill: {path}. Move it aside yourself before retrying.
agent.unsafe_path: Refusing a symlink or non-regular skill path: {path}
init.agent_failed: Workspace initialized, but the {target} skill was not installed ({code}). Resolve the conflict or permissions, then retry: doklo agent setup --target {target}
